_comment: Data-driven question set for the clarify interview. The clarify-interview.md fragment is a generic DRIVER that iterates this data; it does NOT inline question prompts, options, defaults, validations, or batch composition. KNOWLEDGE per docs/unit-taxonomy-spec.md (these evolve — new regions, new compliance frameworks, reworded prompts — independently of the interview algorithm). The output artifact SHAPE is the contract in schemas/preferences.schema.json.

inventory_facts._comment: Facts the driver derives ONCE from heroku-resource-inventory.json; question triggers + fast-path reference these by name.
inventory_facts.postgres_plan: the detected heroku-postgresql plan tier (for the Q6c size hint)

fast_path._comment: Offered only when eligible; if accepted, ask only ask_questions (+ Q11 if has_fir) and default everything else.
fast_path.eligible_when: total_apps < 5 AND NOT has_space AND NOT has_kafka

extra_defaults._comment: Fast-path-only defaults beyond each question's own default.

fast_path.offer_prompt: Your stack looks straightforward — {N} app(s), no Private Spaces, no Kafka. Want to use smart defaults and answer just 4–6 questions? I'll apply sensible defaults for the rest.

_batch_notes: Present batches in this order. Within a batch present only the ACTIVE questions (trigger true). A batch with no active questions is skipped. Batch 2 always has at least Q10; batch 3 always has Q12b/Q12/Q13/Q14/Q15.

Q1.label: Target AWS region
Q1.prompt: Which AWS region should your infrastructure be deployed to?

options.label: Other (specify a valid AWS region code)

Q1.validation: must be a valid AWS region code; reject non-existent codes

Q2.label: Compliance
Q2.prompt: Do you need to meet any compliance frameworks?

Q3.label: Availability posture
Q3.prompt: What availability level does your production workload need?

Q4.label: Maintenance window
Q4.prompt: When should AWS perform maintenance operations?

Q5.label: Environment naming
Q5.prompt: What should the primary environment be called in AWS resource naming and tags?

Q6.label: Database HA
Q6.prompt: For your PostgreSQL database(s), what high-availability configuration do you want on AWS?

Q6b.label: Migration approach
Q6b._canonical_note: CANONICAL migration-approach question. Upstream listed it twice (Q5b global + Q6b data) — same constraint. Ask ONCE here; record under id Q6b only. There is NO separate 'migration urgency' question (that is only a fast-path default migration_urgency:routine).
Q6b.prompt: How would you like to sequence the migration?

options.label: Full cutover (DB + app together, one window)
Data-first interim cutover (DB now, app stays on Heroku temporarily)

interim_cutover_data_first.ask: What's your target date to complete the app migration off Heroku? (YYYY-MM-DD)
interim_cutover_data_first.validation: ISO 8601 date AND in the future; re-prompt if invalid

then_set.global.ktlo_warning: Heroku is in sustaining engineering. Hybrid operation should be bounded to weeks, not quarters.

Q6c.label: DB migration method
Q6c.prompt: How would you like to migrate your PostgreSQL data to AWS?

options.label: AWS DMS (shorter downtime, large DBs; one-time bulk + final cutover, no CDC with Heroku)
WAL-G (WAL-based, minimal downtime large DBs; extra EC2)

Q6c.size_hint: use postgres_plan max storage as an UPPER-BOUND estimate: < 10GB -> recommend pg_dump_restore; >= 10GB -> recommend dms; near-zero-downtime regardless -> bucardo/wal_g. If user gives an actual size, use it and set data.db_size_source='user_override', else 'plan_derived'.
Q6c.design_impact: dms selection carries the CDC-limitation warning (Heroku does not grant the REPLICATION role).

Q7.label: Redis HA
Q7.prompt: Should your Redis cluster on AWS include Multi-AZ with automatic failover?

Q8.label: Kafka retention
Q8.prompt: How long should Kafka messages be retained on AWS MSK?

Q9.label: VPC subnet IDs
Q9.trigger: peering_detected AND subnet IDs not already known
Q9.prompt: Your Private Space has VPC peering. Provide 1–6 AWS subnet IDs (comma-separated) so we reference the existing VPC.
Q9.validation: each must match ^subnet-[0-9a-f]{17}$; accept 1–6; on bad format re-prompt: 'Invalid subnet ID format. Expected subnet-xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx (subnet- + 17 hex chars). Provide 1–6 valid subnet IDs, comma-separated.'
Q9.no_default_note: MUST be answered if it fires (cannot reference an existing VPC without it).

Q9b.label: VPC ID
Q9b.prompt: I detected VPC peering but couldn't find the AWS VPC ID. Provide your existing AWS VPC ID.
Q9b.validation: must match ^vpc-[0-9a-f]{17}$; on bad format re-prompt: 'Invalid VPC ID format. Expected vpc-xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx (vpc- + 17 hex chars).'
Q9b.no_default_note: MUST be answered if it fires.

Q10.label: DNS strategy
Q10.prompt: How do you want to manage DNS for your migrated services?

Q11.label: Fir intent
Q11.prompt: I detected Fir-generation app(s). What's your compute migration intent for these Fir workloads?

options.label: Exit Heroku entirely (re-platform to AWS, ECS/Fargate)

Q11.design_impact: Both fully migrate Fir to AWS; B signals self-managed orchestration. Cutover timing is Q6b, not this. Fir workloads remain deferred in v1.

Q12b.label: Containerization status
Q12b.prompt: Is your application already containerized (has a Dockerfile)?

Q12c.label: Kubernetes preference
Q12c.prompt: Would you prefer EKS (Kubernetes) or ECS Fargate for your containerized workloads?
Q12c.design_impact: EKS values map all formations to EKS Deployments downstream; non-formation resources unaffected. Fir intent (Q11) precedence: the global kubernetes preference wins for non-Fir formations.

Q12.label: Container registry
Q12.prompt: Where should container images be stored?

Q13.label: Log retention
Q13.prompt: How long should application logs be retained in CloudWatch Logs?

Q14.label: Alerting
Q14.prompt: How do you want to handle alerting and on-call notifications?

Q15.label: Cost optimization
Q15.prompt: How aggressively should we optimize for cost vs. operational safety?
